title: Writing: A Professional Cover Letter and Career Reflection

writingModel.placeholder: State the position you are applying for and where you saw the advertisement
writingModel.hint: Be specific and direct — do not begin with "I am writing to apply"

writingModel.placeholder: Describe your most relevant experience and achievements
writingModel.hint: Use reporting verbs: "I have led…", "The team I managed…", "I was recognised for…"

writingModel.placeholder: Explain why this role and organisation appeal to you specifically
writingModel.hint: Show you have researched the organisation — mention specific projects, values, or goals

writingModel.placeholder: Express enthusiasm and request an interview
writingModel.hint: Be confident but not arrogant: "I would welcome the opportunity to discuss…"

writingTemplate.prefix: I am applying for the position of
writingTemplate.hint: State the role clearly at the start
State your current position and a key achievement
writingTemplate.placeholder: Data Analyst at Horizon NGO / led a team of six on a cross-border research project

writingTemplate.prefix: I am particularly drawn to your organisation because
writingTemplate.placeholder: you have committed to data-driven policy advocacy in under-resourced communities
writingTemplate.hint: Show specific knowledge of the organisation

writingTemplate.prefix: My colleagues have described me as
writingTemplate.hint: Use reporting language to show self-awareness
writingTemplate.placeholder: someone who brings both technical rigour and creative thinking / this combination is what this role demands

writingTemplate.prefix: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss
writingTemplate.placeholder: how my experience and values align with your organisation's mission

items: I am writing to express my interest in…
I am applying for the position of…, as advertised…
Having followed your organisation's work for some time…
I am excited to apply for…, a role that aligns closely with my expertise in…
I am a [role] with [X] years of experience in…
In my current role, I have led / managed / coordinated…
My colleagues have recognised me for…
I have been described as someone who…
The team I managed successfully delivered…
I proposed and implemented a new system that…
I am particularly drawn to your organisation because…
What excites me most about this role is…
Your commitment to [value] resonates strongly with…
I would argue that my background in [area] positions me well to…
This role represents exactly the kind of challenge I am seeking.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application further.
I am available for interview at your convenience.
Please find my CV attached for your consideration.
I look forward to hearing from you.
I am confident that I can contribute meaningfully to your team.

questions.text: "She ___ applying for a more senior position once she had two years of experience." (she planned this)
"My colleagues have ___ (describe) me as someone who brings both creativity and analytical rigour."
questions.hint: Present perfect passive: "have been described as"

questions.text: "I ___ to bring these skills to your organisation." (expressing eagerness to contribute)
"The hiring manager ___ (acknowledge) that the selection process had taken longer than expected."
questions.hint: "Acknowledged" = admitted, often of a problem or delay

questions.text: Which is the most professional opening for a cover letter?
opts: I want this job very much and think I am perfect.
Hi, I am applying for the analyst role.
I am writing to express my interest in the Senior Analyst position, as advertised on your website.
Someone told me about this job and I think it suits me.
questions.correct: I am writing to express my interest in the Senior Analyst position, as advertised on your website.

questions.text: "I proposed and implemented a system that increased efficiency by 30%" uses a reporting verb correctly.
questions.hint: "Proposed" = put forward a formal plan (reporting verb + direct object)

questions.text: "___ been ___ that cover letters should be no longer than one page." (it is recommended)
questions.hint: "It has been suggested that" = formal passive reporting

questions.text: "I would welcome the opportunity ___ my experience in more detail."
